# FG-GIT-0036

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 500 |
| 重大度 | alert |
| Runbook | [`ssh-transport`](../../ops/runbooks/ssh-transport.md) |
| 発生させるテスト | `an_unreadable_bridge_answer_is_fg_git_0036` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: SSH での git の操作に失敗しました。問い合わせ番号を添えて管理者に連絡してください。
- en: The git operation over SSH failed. Contact the administrator with the request ID.
- id: Operasi git melalui SSH gagal. Hubungi administrator dengan menyertakan ID permintaan.

## 原因 (cause)

M4 C13 (ADR-0032): the SSH git transport itself failed — not git and not authorization (those keep their own codes, e.g. FG-GIT-0014, FG-REPO-0005, FG-GIT-0007, which the client receives in-band unchanged). `reason`: `accept` (the listener's accept failed, usually out of file descriptors; the loop pauses 100 ms and goes on), `session` (an SSH session ended with an internal error after authentication), `bridge` (the in-process request to the Smart HTTP route could not be built, or its answer could not be read: a body stream error, an error answer that is not the JSON error body), `server_stopped` (the SSH listener ended while `forge serve` still ran: SSH stays unavailable until a restart). A client that leaves mid-transfer is not this code (logged at debug).

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

One log line `forge.ssh.failed` with `error_code=FG-GIT-0036`, `request_id` (the SSH command's id, when there was one), `reason`, `ssh_key_id` / `user_id` (after authentication), `service` and `source` (the underlying error text). For `bridge`, `http_status` and `http_request_id` (the Smart HTTP request's own id: its lines carry it) when the request got that far.

## 対処 (fix)

accept: raise the open-files limit (`LimitNOFILE`) and restart. server_stopped: read the preceding error, then restart `forge serve` (an approved step). session / bridge: a defect — attach the log lines to the incident; HTTPS clone and push keep working meanwhile. Runbook ssh-transport.
